method: Deterministic SVG: each original JPEG byte sequence is embedded as a data URL and clipped into a viewBox; separate vector annotations identify controls and selection. No application pixels were redrawn or raster-edited.

styling.matte: pure gray #808080 at 0.25 fill opacity, visible only around the screenshot crops
styling.annotations: Muted blue #79acd2 target frames and arrows; continuous arrow paths with dark outlines; dark labels with broad pale outlines and soft white glow.

styling.theme_review: Not browser-rendered in this run; figures derive from the supplied dark-theme native captures.
